title: YQP-star languages lie in APP through amplified quantum-advice verification
author: Justin Yirka
work: Even Quantum Advice is Unlikely to Solve PP
source_version: Theory of Computing21 (2025), Article7, publisher source publicationOctober 2, 2025; DOI10.4086/toc.2025.v021a007

source_locator.proof_scope: Complete author argument including supplied core constructions

difficulty_reason: The inclusion YQP*⊆APP requires expressing an amplified quantum verifier on maximally mixed advice as a ratio of GapP acceptance probabilities whose denominator depends only on input length. The proof must preserve eigenstates under in-place amplification and control the contribution of bad advice in both YES and NO instances; these are the authors’ substantive new obligations rather than a routine application of a standard class containment.

source_check.note: Full definitions in Section2, in-place Marriott–Watrous amplification and Lemma2.20 eigenstate-preservation observation, all retained; complete Section3 proof ratio of GapP acceptance probabilities on maximally mixed advice.
